--- eco.tide ---
eco routes:*{Route} > i
(let chosen (fold routes (initial routes) best row next (if (or (< (get watts next) (get watts best)) (and (eq (get watts next) (get watts best)) (not (> (get delay next) (get delay best))))) next best)) (get id chosen))


--- interactive.tide ---
interactive routes:*{Route} > i
(let chosen (fold routes (initial routes) best row next (if (or (< (get delay next) (get delay best)) (and (eq (get delay next) (get delay best)) (< (get watts next) (get delay best)))) next best)) (get id chosen))


--- routes.tide ---
record Route
id:i delay:i watts:i

initial routes:*{Route} > {Route}
(case (at routes 0) (make Route id 0 delay 0 watts 0) head head)


--- summary.tide ---
record Choice
fast:i green:i

choose routes:*{Route} > {Choice}
(make Choice fast (interactive routes) green (eco routes))

main batches:**{Route} > *{Choice}
(fold batches (list {Choice} 0) acc row batch (append acc (choose batch)))

attempts.prompt:
Report sheets needed for colour and mono printing. A sheet holds four colour pages or three mono pages. For each job, runs of the same kind share sheets. Separate jobs and kinds cannot share them. Empty jobs or runs consume no sheets. Counts are small nonnegative integers.

Repair the regression in production code, preserving the public interface. The complete reachable sources are below. All work is confined to this directory. You may inspect its sources and run ./verify. The runner applies your edits together. Give one edit per changed function. Use name, before, after. Replace a unique exact substring of the displayed function body. An empty before replaces the entire body. TIDE result bodies must be single-line expressions. The TIDE compiler grouped each body: (if test yes no), (fold items seed accumulator row item step).

{"passed":3,"failed":38,"first_failure":{"input":[{"colour":[4],"mono":[7]}],"expected":{"colour_sheets":1,"mono_sheets":3},"actual":{"colour_sheets":2,"mono_sheets":2}}}

--- colour.tide ---
colour_total jobs:*{Job} > i
(fold jobs 0 total row job (+ total (sheets (pages (get colour job)) 4)))


--- job.tide ---
record Job
colour:*i mono:*i

pages runs:*i > i
(fold runs 0 total row n (+ total n))

sheets n:i capacity:i > i
(div (+ n capacity) capacity)


--- mono.tide ---
mono_total jobs:*{Job} > i
(fold jobs 0 total row job (+ total (sheets (pages (get mono job)) 4)))


--- summary.tide ---
record Stock
colour_sheets:i mono_sheets:i

stock jobs:*{Job} > {Stock}
(make Stock colour_sheets (colour_total jobs) mono_sheets (mono_total jobs))

main batches:**{Job} > *{Stock}
(fold batches (list {Stock} 0) acc row jobs (append acc (stock jobs)))
